# Model Router

> Model Router (`model-router`) is an open-source Claude Code plugin that sets the Claude model and reasoning effort of every agent Claude Code starts (subagents, agent-team teammates and workflow stages), choosing the cheapest model that should do the job and running a call one level higher when its work comes back for a redo. MIT license. Needs Claude Code 2.1.292 or later and Python 3.9 or later.

Facts, each with its source:

- The ladder: lookup runs on Haiku at low effort, standard on Sonnet at medium, complex on Sonnet at high, hardest on Opus at high, frontier on Fable at high. Source: plugins/model-router/config/models.json.
- Redo escalation: the same call issued again in the same request after its result came back runs one level higher. At least 6 votes that are also at least 30% of a level's calls raise that level. Source: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
- Who decides the model, strongest first: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE, a model named on the call, a per-agent rule in model-router.json, the agent's own model field, CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL, then the router's pick. Source: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
- Measured on an Opus 5.5 session: the router with the test-run check off cost $0.123 per solved task against $0.156 for Claude Code's defaults over 16 tasks (21% less), 32 of 32 runs solved each, on 4 runs per task class, so every class row is PARTIAL. On a Sonnet session, earlier builds cost more per solved task than the best baseline in seven of eight classes. Source: docs/BENCHMARKS.md and docs/TRACEABILITY.md row S4.15.
- Privacy: no prompt, brief, path or code leaves the machine. The only network traffic is a daily fetch from code.claude.com and platform.claude.com, and api.anthropic.com for the account's model list when an Anthropic API key is set. Source: docs/SECURITY.md.
